Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for setting up the onboarding session last week. We had an internal conflict pop up and need to move the hands-on runbook walkthrough that was penciled in for next Tuesday.

Primary ask: can we shift focus for the next session to the API enablement path (service accounts, sandbox keys, and a short integration lab) — the console overview can be trimmed to 15 min. Our dev lead (Olivia) and two SREs will join.

Availability this week: Tue/Wed before 1pm PT, or Thursday afternoon after 3pm PT.

Also: Can you share a short preflight checklist for access so we can get permissions ready? If we need a sandbox service account with specific IPs, let me know and I’ll open a ticket with our infra team.

Appreciate it — Oliver

Director of Platform Engineering
Skyline Health

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook walkthrough window & access preflight

Hi Oliver — great to hear and totally doable.

Quick proposal:
- Slot A: Tue 11 May, 11:00–12:30 PT — focused API enablement + 30m lab
- Slot B: Wed 12 May, 10:00–11:30 PT — same agenda but earlier window
- Slot C: Thu 13 May, 15:30–17:00 PT — afternoon deeper dive if you want extra QA time

If none of those work, tell me your single best 90-minute window and I’ll coordinate.

Attached is the prework checklist (prework-checklist.pdf) — it lists required roles, network requirements, and the exact IAM scopes we ask you to provision for a temporary sandbox service account. Two quick asks from our side before we confirm:
1) Can you provide the email address you want us to pre-create the sandbox service account for?
2) Do your SREs need IP allowlist instructions (we can provide sample entries)?

Marissa (CS) will send the calendar invite once you confirm and will include the Zoom details + recording toggle. Dev will be hosting the lab portion — tagging @dev for quick readiness on sandbox access.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan

Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook walkthrough window & access preflight

Quick internal note — we should be ready for any of the proposed slots. A couple operational details:

- I’ll be the host for the lab and will pre-seed the sandbox with the sample dataset and keys. I’ll attach the short run instructions (sandbox-access-steps.md) for the SREs so they can set IPs/roles ahead of time.
- Sandbox service accounts: we can create one that’s scoped to read-only ML artifacts + inference tokens (no billing permissions). Ask the customer to send the target email and we’ll pre-create and deliver the key via secure shared link.
- Recording and breakout labs: recommend enabling recording and giving the SREs breakout control so they can copy post-session. Also recommend 30 minutes of hands-on split into 3 short exercises.

I’ll be online during the Slot A and Slot B times; Slot C we can cover but I’ll bring an extra engineer just in case.

—Dev

--
